title: The Golem (character)
description:
[h2]The Golem: a new playable character[/h2]
A hulking construct of river clay and mossy boulders. [b]Parts[/b] are power cards that slot into Head, Arms, Legs and Core; installing a new Part replaces the old one, and many cards scale with how many Parts you have.

HP 80. Starting relic: Heart of Clay. 87 cards.

[h3]Good to know[/h3]
[list]
[*]Changes gameplay: everyone in a multiplayer lobby needs the same version.
[*]Requires BaseLib (subscribed automatically as a required item).
[*]Personal fan project, not affiliated with Mega Crit.
[/list]
changeNote: v0.4.1: Living Fortress raises Plating to 1 per Part (all Parts count) instead of stacking.
